tools.name: zcr_read
tools.description: Read a bounded UTF-8 file range in the bound workspace. Use write_intent=true to obtain the whole-file digest needed for an exact patch.

path.description: Relative UTF-8 path; byte length<=4096 and OS limit enforced at runtime; no .., absolute, NUL, or policy escape.

consistency.description: Other modes are not exposed by v1 input; managed/stale require enabled capability and explicit policy.

tools.name: zcr_files
tools.description: List matching paths under the approved root, with ignore filtering and explicit coverage. Live traversal is the default.

consistency.description: Other modes are not exposed by v1 input; managed/stale require enabled capability and explicit policy.

tools.name: zcr_search
tools.description: Find an exact case-sensitive literal with limited surrounding context. Prefer a narrow glob; results report completeness and original byte spans.

consistency.description: Other modes are not exposed by v1 input; managed/stale require enabled capability and explicit policy.

tools.name: zcr_batch_read
tools.description: Read up to 32 independent ranges from one bound workspace in one call. Per-item errors and input order are retained.

path.description: Relative UTF-8 path; byte length<=4096 and OS limit enforced at runtime; no .., absolute, NUL, or policy escape.

consistency.description: Other modes are not exposed by v1 input; managed/stale require enabled capability and explicit policy.

tools.name: zcr_status
tools.description: Inspect only the bound task/workspace status or a receipt from the current security domain.

tools.name: zcr_health
tools.description: Report actual enabled capabilities, resource limits, and available pressure signals without exposing source text or other sessions.
